subject: Re: Joint webinar opportunity — Orbis AI x Redwood: Embeddable LLM Features
messages:
From: Anya Petrov <anya@orbis-ai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ricardo Alvarez <ricardo@orbis-ai.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Joint webinar proposal — Orbis AI x Redwood

Hi Karthik,

Hope you’re well. I’m Anya, Head of Partnerships at Orbis AI — we build domain-specialized LLMs and a lightweight SDK for embedding model inference into enterprise SaaS. We’ve been working with a few ISVs that are embedding models and seeing interesting adoption patterns; I think there’s a great story to tell with Redwood around serving & cost-optimization for embeddable features.

Would Redwood be interested in co-hosting a 45-minute webinar (30-min demo + 15-min panel/Q&A) in late January? We’ve drafted a one-pager attached with audience targets (ISV product leads, platform teams) and proposed topics: model sizing for edge-like deployments, routing/variants for cost control, and best practices for observability in production.

High-level asks from Orbis: a Redwood technical speaker, a short pre-recorded demo (5–7m) showing the integration flow, and help promoting via your partner newsletter / field lists. We’ll cover paid social and our invite list; we’re hoping Redwood can cross-promote and supply a content asset (blog or playbook) to gate registration.

If this sounds interesting, suggested dates: Jan 24, Jan 31, or Feb 7. I attached a one-pager and included a brief draft agenda inside.

Thanks — look forward to hearing thoughts.

Best,
Anya Petrov
Head of Partnerships, Orbis AI
anya@orbis-ai.com
Attachment: orbis-redwood-webinar-onepager.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Petrov <anya@orbis-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Joint webinar proposal — Orbis AI x Redwood

Thanks Anya — excited about this. The topic maps nicely to what our field has been asking for. Quick answers and asks from our side: 

- We can commit a technical speaker (I’ll line up someone from our Serving Runtime team).
- Promotion: Marissa (cc’d) will help with the co-marketing plan and email cadence.
- Content asset: we can produce a short playbook (1k–1.5k words) and a pair of demo snippets — fine to gate registration.

Dates: Jan 31 looks best for us (avoids holidays). Can we lock Jan 31, 10:00am PT? If that works we’ll move into logistics: run of show, speaker bios, slide deck and recording plan.

Two asks before we confirm: can you share any attendee personas / list segments you’ll invite, and is Orbis able to share a short customer case we could highlight on the panel? Also tagging Jonas for content / deck alignment.

I’ll add Ben Carter to the thread after we have preliminary logistics for field amplification.

Cheers,
Karthik
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Petrov <anya@orbis-ai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-10T09:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Joint webinar proposal — Orbis AI x Redwood

Thanks, team — jumping in on logistics. 

Attached is a quick draft run-of-show (draft-run-of-show.xlsx) and a proposed task list:
- Confirm speakers & 1-sentence bios by 2026-12-17
- Gather 5–7 demo assets (pre-recorded clips) by 2026-12-27
- Deck draft due 2027-01-14 for review
- Registration page live by 2027-01-10
- Co-marketing plan: 2 email sends (2 weeks and 3 days prior), social posts, and partner blog swap post for the week after the webinar

Speaker suggestions from Redwood: Neha Kapoor (runtime lead) for the technical segment, and I recommend we round out the panel with 1 PM from Orbis + 1 customer. If Orbis has a customer happy to speak we can tighten the panel.

A few operational notes: we prefer Zoom webinar (Redwood account) so we can control recording and post-event asset hosting. We’ll provide an embed of the registration form and the playbook PDF for gated downloads.

Link to the draft run-of-show: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/webinar-run-of-show

Marissa Cole
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: draft-run-of-show.xlsx
From: Anya Petrov <anya@orbis-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ricardo Alvarez <ricardo@orbis-ai.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Joint webinar proposal — Orbis AI x Redwood

Perfect — Jan 31, 10:00am PT works for us, and Zoom webinar is fine. We have a customer (ShiftLogic) willing to join for 10 minutes to talk implementation and outcomes; I’ll loop in their comms lead next cycle for bios and logistics.

I’ve attached a finalized one-pager (see earlier attachment) and we’ll plan to share our invite segments (mostly product leads at mid-market/enterprise ISVs) by EOD Monday. For co-marketing: we’ll write the initial promotional copy and share a blog draft for the swap the week after the event.

Forwarded message below for the host team — please confirm speaker names and we’ll lock recording/ops.

Best,
Anya
Head of Partnerships, Orbis AI
